title: Differential graded Hopf algebra structure on free symmetric cosimplicial operads
summary: Motivated by the recent work of Batkam-Tcheka on pointed multiplicative operads, we construct in this paper new chain complex algebras and two distinct bicomplex algebra structures on a free symmetric connected multiplicative differential graded operad. Furthermore, we focus on the non-differential graded case and construct a differential graded Hopf algebra structure using the odot product together with an analogue of the Alexander-Whitney homomorphism and a compatible differential.
